newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi, LG say halt Malaysia chip project.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi, LG say halt Malaysia chip project.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd said on Friday that it and South Korean partner LG Semicon Co Ltd had decided to halt feasibility studies on the construction of a semiconductor plant in Malaysia.
LG Semicon is a member of the LG Group.

"Sharp drops in the prices of memory chips since the beginning of the this year have caused market conditions to take a rapid turn for the worse... This has made it difficult to proceed" with the project, the two companies said in a statement.
Hitachi and LG Semicon had planned to establish a semiconductor wafer fabrication company in Malaysia's Kedah Province.
They had planned to start construction by the end of this year and begin production of 16-megabit and 64-megabit dynamic random-access memory chips in early 1998.
